findings: Bottom navigation state doesn't persist — The home screen's _selectedBottomItem tracks which nav item is active, but navigating to another screen and returning resets it to 0. Use a state management solution or pass selected index via route arguments if cross-screen persistence is needed.

Mock data not persisted — Expenses, user profile, and spending totals use hardcoded values. The save/update buttons show success snackbars but don't persist changes. Wire these to Firebase Firestore (already in pubspec.yaml) or Hive local storage to make the app functional.
